summary: Space Exploration Technologies Corp. filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to report a $25.0 billion senior unsecured notes offering across five tranches: $7.0B 5.350% notes due 2031, $6.0B 5.650% notes due 2033, $6.0B 5.875% notes due 2036, $2.5B 6.600% notes due 2046, and $3.5B 6.650% notes due 2056. The notes were issued under an indenture with The Bank of New York Mellon Trust Company, N.A. as trustee, sold to QIBs via Rule 144A and non-U.S. persons via Regulation S. Interest is payable semi-annually, with customary redemption provisions. This is a routine debt financing, not a special situation; no deal terms are applicable.
